description: Defines an immutable class 'ImmutableJsonArray' representing a JSON array with methods for creation, manipulation, and serialization. Includes internal classes for handling cached representations and JSON parsing.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonArray
classes.description: An immutable class representing a JSON array, supporting creation, addition of elements, retrieval, and serialization.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonArray.SoftReferencedValueList
classes.description: Handles cached representations (JSON string and CBOR) of the JSON array, with methods for cache management, parsing, and serialization.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonArray.ValueListJsonHandler
classes.description: A JSON parser handler for creating a List<JsonValue> from JSON array strings, supporting nested arrays and objects.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of an empty ImmutableJsonArray.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableJsonArray from a list of JsonValue, with optional string and CBOR representations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Returns a new ImmutableJsonArray with the specified element added.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index, wrapped in Optional.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the array is empty.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the array.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a value is present in the array.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Returns the index of a value in the array.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the array elements.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a Stream of the array elements.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Serializes the array to the provided SerializationContext.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Estimates the maximum size of the array's string representation.
